name: Cursed Blood's Bloodbolt debuff lands on the target (#806)
contract: Cursed Blood 681792 has three effects. Effects 1 and 2 (aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, BasePoints 19) are native damage modifiers and already work. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Cursed Blood 803722, a native debuff (aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE BasePoints -21 with RealPointsPerLevel -1.14583 and MiscValue 126, plus aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN BasePoints 1, both TargetA 6 = enemy). Spell.dbc gives 681792 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'damage dealt by Bloodbolt now reduces all resistances ... and increases the target's Magic damage taken by $803722s2%' at ProcChance 100, so a single Bloodbolt must apply 803722 to the unit it hits. Bloodbolt is cast as rank 578305, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h; it is DmgClass 1 and its SpellFamilyFlags (0, 131072, 0) are the bit the row's SpellFamilyMask1 names. No proc roll is involved.
